title: Barfresh Food Group Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-06
summary: Barfresh Food Group Inc. (ticker: BRFH), a small beverage/food company listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K on April 6, 2026 reporting board changes. Director Isabelle Ortiz-Cochet retired effective March 31, 2026. Unibel's designee Marc Panvier and former chief customer officer Tim Trant were appointed as new directors effective April 1, 2026. The filing also references an investor rights agreement between the company and Unibel.
key_points: Isabelle Ortiz-Cochet resigned from the board effective March 31, 2026; her departure was not due to disagreement with the company
Marc Panvier was appointed as Unibel's board designee effective April 1, 2026, to serve on the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee
Tim Trant was appointed as a director effective April 1, 2026, to serve on the Audit and Compensation Committees
Tim Trant previously served as chief customer officer from June 2015 to December 2019 and has been a consultant since
The board changes were governed by an investor rights agreement with Unibel dated November 23, 2016
